label: D1 after unrewarded rare a1->S2, larger when belief favors S1, fading late
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (last_is("a1 S2 u") + (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 0)) * ep_dec
explanation: Fires only at D1 and essentially only after an unrewarded rare a1->S2 trial (indicator alone: dev R^2 beyond timing 0.63). Magnitude within that case rises with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (belief_lo, weight ~+0.33), i.e. stronger when the history says S1 is good so the rare-unrewarded outcome argues for repeating a1, and declines over the episode (ep_dec, weight ~-0.07). Many large residuals sit on the first trial of the window where the previous trial is outside the data; treating an unrewarded first-trial D1 as a possible a1 S2 u case (with its own belief_lo modulation) raises dev R^2 from 0.64 to 0.71. GO and D2 are always zero. Trial-before reward and belief_cover add nothing. Observed-only dev 0.735, test 0.70 vs the all-cue ceiling 0.72 and all-observed 0.68; the earlier policy-based explanation is not needed (policy decile alone scores 0.38), so dropping model outputs loses essentially nothing.

issues: Minor: the dev R^2 beyond timing for the claimed terms reproduces as 0.725, not the stated 0.735. Test reproduces exactly at 0.702.

The label leaves out the first-trial term (unrewarded D1 where the previous trial is outside the window, treated as a possible a1 S2 u case). Without it, a1 S2 u + belief_lo + ep_dec scores 0.647 on test against 0.702 with it, so about 0.06 of the score comes from a data-window artefact rather than from the behaviour the label describes.

About 30% of the variance is still unexplained, but I found no systematic class that observed or future cues can fix. The misses command shows small, uniform mean errors: D1 over-predicted by about 0.11 for every non-target previous trial, GO and D2 +0.046 (an intercept effect). Adding trial-before state, reward, common or action, belief_cover, belief>0.5, ep_trial<3 or d1_err adds at most 0.01 on test. Even the future next choice (action==1) only lifts test to 0.722, which is the all-cue ceiling of 0.72. The worst misses (a1 S2 u D1s with activation near 0) are scattered.
